title: J003: Add Kubernetes E2E test with kind and DaemonSet
summary: Self-contained Kubernetes E2E test using kind. Creates a local cluster, builds and loads plexd + mock-api images, applies all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests (namespace, CRDs, serviceaccount, RBAC, secret, configmap, DaemonSet), deploys mock-api as Deployment + ClusterIP Service, waits for rollout, port-forwards to mock-api, and validates registration_count >= 1 and heartbeat_count >= 1 via /test/assertions. Cleanup trap deletes the kind cluster on any exit. Makefile target test-e2e-k8s and reference documentation added.

tests_checklist.item: E2E test script exists at test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh
All deploy/kubernetes/ manifests applied (namespace, CRDs x2, serviceaccount, RBAC, secret, configmap, DaemonSet)
Kind cluster deleted on exit via EXIT trap (success and failure)
Diagnostic output (pods, describe, logs) printed on failure
Port-forward background process killed in cleanup trap

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing test/e2e/docker/test.sh patterns (structure, polling, cleanup)
set -euo pipefail for strict error handling
Clear section comments with REQ-ID references
Configurable variables (CLUSTER_NAME, TIMEOUT) with sensible defaults
No dead code or commented-out code

security_checklist.item: Bootstrap token is test fixture (e2e-test-token), not a production secret
No path traversal or injection risks in script

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is as simple as possible — linear shell script
Reuses existing deploy/kubernetes/ manifests (validates production configs)
Test namespace (plexd-e2e) avoids collision with production namespace
sed-based manifest patching is appropriate for E2E context

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No duplicated code — diagnostics factored into print_diagnostics()

fail_fast_checklist.item: Pre-flight checks for required tools (docker, kind, kubectl, curl, jq)
set -euo pipefail aborts on first error
DaemonSet rollout timeout with explicit failure message
Assertion polling timeout with explicit failure counters

defensive_checklist.item: Pre-existing kind cluster deleted before creation
Port-forward PID checked with kill -0 before killing
All cleanup commands use 2>/dev/null || true to prevent cascading failures
RESPONSE variable checked for emptiness before jq parsing

issues_found.description: Missing explicit imagePullPolicy: Never on mock-api container. Task 1.1 specified 'imagePullPolicy: Never for kind compatibility'. The default IfNotPresent works with kind-loaded images, but explicit Never is more defensive and matches the plan.
issues_found.fix: Add 'imagePullPolicy: Never' to the mock-api container spec after 'image: mockapi:e2e'.

issues_found.description: print_diagnostics() is called unconditionally in cleanup(), meaning diagnostics are printed even on successful test runs. The Docker E2E test only prints logs on failure.
issues_found.fix: Track test result in a variable and conditionally call print_diagnostics only on failure, or accept the noise for simpler code.

issues_found.description: CRDs are applied but not explicitly verified with 'kubectl get crd'. Story 5 specifies 'kubectl get crd plexdnodestates.plexd.plexsphere.com succeeds'. set -e catches apply failures, but explicit verification would catch registration delays.
issues_found.fix: Optional: add 'kubectl get crd plexdnodestates.plexd.plexsphere.com' and 'kubectl get crd plexdhooks.plexd.plexsphere.com' after CRD application.

suggested_improvements: Add imagePullPolicy: Never to mock-api container in mock-api-manifests.yaml for consistency with plan and DaemonSet patching
Consider gating print_diagnostics() in cleanup on a failure flag to reduce success-path output noise
Consider adding explicit CRD verification (kubectl get crd) after CRD application for completeness
